_README: Copy this file to connections.json and fill in only the platforms you want. connections.json is gitignored - your real tokens never get committed. Easiest way: run the dashboard and use the Connections page instead of editing this by hand.

youtube._note: OAuth client secret goes in config/youtube_client.json (see README). privacy: private|unlisted|public

tiktok._note: OAuth client goes in config/tiktok_client.json. Public posting needs TikTok API audit approval; until then posts are private.
